purpose: Reviewed rioforce flat-art to catalog component crosswalks. These are promoted only where character/version/surface evidence independently identifies the decorated component.
policy: Verified records may be used as exact flat-art supervision for the stated component/version.
Catalog aliases are preserved rather than forced into one identifier namespace.
Do not generalize one verified asset to later recolors/redraws unless separately crosswalked.
